title: 118쪽 · 3x CO Open —+ BTN 3-Bet + CO 4-Bet > BTN 5-Bet [Part 1] (All-in)
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: The button should be 3-betting so wide that the cutoff should be 4-betting with 10-10+/A-K and enough random bluffs that the button can profitably 5-bet shove J-J+/A-K when you consider fold equity. Snowie is very rarely flatting with 100bb. As I said earlier, you want to force the Villain to surrender all of his equity or inflate the size of the pot when you have an equity advantage.
